You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From bd53280ef042301ea9663824568ecba5a88b2f9d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Janusz Krzysztofik <janusz.krzysztofik@linux.intel.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2019 15:32:31 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/drv: Fix incorrect resolution of merge conflict

Commit f06ddb53096b ("BackMerge v5.1-rc5 into drm-next") incorrectly
resolved a merge conflict related to a patch having been merged twice:
- commit 3f04e0a6cfeb ("drm: Fix drm_release() and device unplug")
  introduced as a standalone fix via drm-fixes branch,
- commit 1ee57d4d75fb ("drm: Fix drm_release() and device unplug")
  applied as patch 1/2 of a series on drm-next branch.
That incorrect resolution of the conflict effectively reverted a change
introduced to drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c by patch 2/2 of that series -
commit ba3bf37e150a ("drm/drv: drm_dev_unplug(): Move out drm_dev_put()
call").  Fix it.

Fixes: f06ddb53096b ("BackMerge v5.1-rc5 into drm-next")
Signed-off-by: Janusz Krzysztofik <janusz.krzysztofik@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Dave Airlie <airlied@redhat.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20190417133232.16232-1-janusz.krzysztofik@linux.intel.com
---
 drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c | 1 -
 1 file changed, 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c
index e87799e3e7ff..50d849d1bc6e 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c
@@ -508,7 +508,6 @@ void drm_dev_unplug(struct drm_device *dev)
 	synchronize_srcu(&drm_unplug_srcu);
 
 	drm_dev_unregister(dev);
-	drm_dev_put(dev);
 }
 EXPORT_SYMBOL(drm_dev_unplug);
 
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The root cause of the bug was an incorrect resolution of a merge conflict during the backmerging of a patch, which led to the unintended reversion of a critical change in the `drm_dev_unplug()` function. Specifically, the change that moved the `drm_dev_put()` call out of the `drm_dev_unplug()` function was inadvertently removed, resulting in improper handling of device reference counting and potential memory management issues.

    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug was an incorrect resolution of a merge conflict during the backmerging of a patch, which led to the unintended reversion of a critical change in the `drm_dev_unplug()` function. Specifically, the change that moved the `drm_dev_put()` call out of the `drm_dev_unplug()` function was inadvertently removed, resulting in improper handling of device reference counting and potential memory management issues.
